card.name: Inside words starting with un-
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the un- start of a word that is split into pieces, such as unn|atural, unt|ouch|able, unt|imely and un|countable. It fires on the first piece or on the pieces just after it.

modes.label: unnatural
modes.description: The un- piece of the word unnatural, split as unn + atural.
modes.example: as an “<<unn>>atural act” and can attract a jail

modes.label: untouchable
modes.description: The middle or end pieces of untouchable(s), a caste term.
modes.example: 'unt<<ouch>>ables,' and their fight is the ultimate

modes.label: other un- words
modes.description: Other rare un- words split into pieces, such as untimely, untreated, uncountable and untoward.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires inside uncommon words that begin with "un-", like unnatural and untouchable, when they are broken into pieces.
